exposure: low Apgar score (<7) at 1, 5 and 10 min of age
cohort: 60 infants with perinatal stroke and a control group
finding: Smoking during pregnancy, 10-minute Apgar score < 7, neonatal infection, and hypoglycaemia were independent risk factors for perinatal stroke.
mod_finding: Emergency cesarean section was identified as a risk factor for perinatal stroke in univariate analysis but not in multivariate analysis.
